```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from compare import comparison_table, coefplot, render_table
```

Stars throughout: <sup>\*</sup> p<0.10, <sup>\*\*</sup> p<0.05, <sup>\*\*\*</sup> p<0.01.
Standard errors in parentheses.

## Balanced vs unbalanced | IDN consumption, urban

```{python}
#| label: idn-bal-vs-unb-table
#| output: asis
fix    = {"country": "IDN", "depvar": "consumption", "choice": "urban"}
versus = {"unbalanced": "cuu", "balanced": "cub"}

table = comparison_table(fix=fix, versus=versus)
print("```{=html}")
print(render_table(table))
print("```")
```

```{python}
#| label: idn-bal-vs-unb-coefplot
#| out-width: "100%"
coefplot(fix=fix, versus=versus);
```

## Main vs experience | IDN consumption, urban (unbalanced)

This table compares our main results for Indonesia to a version that adds years of working experience as a covariate in all columns.

```{python}
#| label: idn-main-vs-exp-table
#| output: asis
fix    = {"country": "IDN", "depvar": "consumption", "choice": "urban", "balance": "unbalanced"}
versus = {"main": {}, "experience": {"family": "exp"}}

table = comparison_table(fix=fix, versus=versus)
print("```{=html}")
print(render_table(table))
print("```")
```

```{python}
#| label: idn-main-vs-exp-coefplot
#| out-width: "100%"
coefplot(fix=fix, versus=versus);
```

## Main vs max experience | IDN consumption, urban (unbalanced)

This table compares our main results for Indonesia to a version that adds maximum years of working experience (the running max of experience over the panel) as a covariate in all columns.

## Main (urban) vs non-agricultural | IDN consumption (unbalanced)

This table compares our main results for Indonesia to a version that uses non-agricultural employment instead of urban location as the treatment.

```{python}
#| label: idn-main-vs-nonag-table
#| output: asis
fix    = {"country": "IDN", "depvar": "consumption", "balance": "unbalanced"}
versus = {"main": {"choice": "urban"}, "non-ag": {"choice": "nonag"}}

table = comparison_table(fix=fix, versus=versus)
print("```{=html}")
print(render_table(table))
print("```")
```

```{python}
#| label: idn-main-vs-nonag-coefplot
#| out-width: "100%"
coefplot(fix=fix, versus=versus);
```

## Main (consumption) vs income | IDN urban (unbalanced)

This table compares our main results for Indonesia to a version that uses log per-capita income as the dependent variable instead of log per-capita consumption.

```{python}
#| label: idn-main-vs-income-table
#| output: asis
fix    = {"country": "IDN", "choice": "urban", "balance": "unbalanced"}
versus = {"consumption": {"depvar": "consumption"}, "income": {"depvar": "income"}}

table = comparison_table(fix=fix, versus=versus)
print("```{=html}")
print(render_table(table))
print("```")
```

```{python}
#| label: idn-main-vs-income-coefplot
#| out-width: "100%"
coefplot(fix=fix, versus=versus);
```
